I'm fighting for the approximately 19k people, including more than 5,400 infants and 10k+ children, in #GA04 who would lose access to Special Supplemental Nutrition Program for Women, Infants, and Children (WIC) benefits because of the Musk-Trump shutdown.

Under @HouseGOP's budget plan, the 109,000 people who receive coverage under the Affordable Care Act in GA-04 would see their average premium go up by $500 per year — a 57% increase.

Many families would face even steeper consequences. A 60-year-old couple with a household income of $85,000 in GA-04 would see their health insurance costs increase by $15,832 per year — a 219% increase in premiums.
